changes.evidence: His first title on file is Eyes of Wakanda (ep. 4 'The Last Panther': in 2016 he stands before the Wakandan axe in the London museum, just before the Black Panther robbery). His U.S. military service (Naval Academy, Navy SEAL, JSOC ghost unit) is a past group told by Everett Ross in Black Panther, so by the settled rule it is keyed to his first title, Eyes of Wakanda. As the record stands he has no group during his Eyes of Wakanda step. He becomes king of Wakanda in Black Panther, so that stage stays.

owner_calls.question: The screen never names the Chinatown street crew that Davos takes over in Iron Fist S2. Keep the dataset's name 'Ryhno's Gang' (a wiki label) for it? A:st-bb-chinatown uses the same group.
options: Rename it to a description of how the screen shows it
owner_calls.evidence: Iron Fist S2: Davos recruits Ryhno's crew of street kids ('What if I could make you warriors?'). The crew has no name on screen, and the wiki calls it 'Ryhno's Gang'. This falls under the open question on names for crews the screen never names.

owner_calls.question: V1: this record covers several fighters (the Veznikov brothers, the Bride of Nine Spiders and Scythe), not one person. Keep it as a group record or split it?
options: Split into one record per fighter
owner_calls.evidence: Iron Fist S1 ep. 6: Danny fights each of Gao's fighters in turn. These are separate characters.

owner_calls.question: V1: this record merges two separate robots, Dum-E and U. Keep it as one combined record or split it?
owner_calls.evidence: Iron Man 2: Dum-E and U act separately (Dum-E helps make the new element, U serves champagne). They are two characters.

owner_calls.question: In Eyes of Wakanda ep. 1, Nkati (the Lion) leaves the War Dogs and rules his own pirate kingdom as its king. The record files him as 'Independent'. Should he instead be in a group for the kingdom he leads? The screen calls it only 'his kingdom', and the wiki label is 'Lion's Kingdom'.
options: Add a stage for the kingdom he leads (name to be decided)
owner_calls.evidence: Eyes of Wakanda ep. 1 'Into the Lion's Den': the Lion rules a kingdom of followers who worship him and fight for him (the Shieldmaiden, the Blademaster and others).
